text:
incident-bot: PAGED oncall - Dedicated router is reporting a surge of 502s and traffic drop to pools in eu-west-1, possible routing fallback loop. Customers impacted: several enterprise tenants. Severity: P1.
alex chen: ack. I'm on it, grabbing metrics.
maria gonzalez: heading to debug, reassigning from infra triage.
alex chen: quick check - router->pool map shows many requests marked as "no_compatible_variant" then retried to eu-west-1 fallback. seeing spikes at 02:12 UTC.
samir patel: adding logs: looks like router is flipping between pool A and pool B repeatedly. probably fallback policy triggering then autoscaler reacting?
li wei: pinging autoscaler metrics - the dedicated pool's "available_slots" metric is flat, but GPU util looks low. might be miswired metric.
ak: @samir can you paste the router decision log for one request id?
samir patel: sure.
```
[router] request_id=req-0a1b2c pool_selected=dedicated-eu-west-1-A variant=redwood-v2 fallback_reason=metric_threshold_mismatch route_attempt=1
[router] request_id=req-0a1b2c pool_selected=dedicated-eu-west-1-B variant=redwood-v2 fallback_reason=region_capacity route_attempt=2
[router] request_id=req-0a1b2c pool_selected=dedicated-eu-west-1-A variant=redwood-v2 fallback_reason=metric_threshold_mismatch route_attempt=3
```
alex chen: that flip-flop matches a hysteresis loop. Could be autoscaler emitting wrong signal (e.g., emitting ready_pods instead of available_slots) so router thinks pool A is full -> fallback to B -> autoscaler sees low util and scales down -> pool A becomes healthy again -> router flips back.
maria gonzalez: confirmed autoscaler is publishing metric name "ready_replicas" into the router topic instead of "available_slots" after the last deploy at 01:58 UTC. deploy-bot shows release r-20240301-17.
eng-ops-bot: deploy r-20240301-17 applied to autoscaler/eu-west-1 at 01:58:23 UTC.
katie roy: oh no, that release included a metric rename. Can we roll that change back?
alex chen: immediate mitigation: update router policy to ignore autoscaler metric so it won't fallback. patching policy to prefer variants by hard-coded pool order for 15m.
li wei: while that's happening, I can scale pool A manually. what target? current desired=6, actual pods=4.
maria gonzalez: scale to 10 temporarily. Samir, do you have the CLI?
samir patel: running: 
```
redwoodctl pools scale --pool dedicated-eu-west-1-A --replicas 10 --reason "incident manual scale"
```
samir patel: applied, status: scaling started.
alex chen: patching router policy now. editing policy config: 
```
fallback_policies:
  - name: temp-lockout-autoscaler
    priority: 100
    conditions:
      - metric_source: manual_override
    action: prefer_pool_order
    duration: 15m
```
alex chen: pushed policy, reloading router.
eng-ops-bot: router config reload triggered by alex chen at 02:25:10 UTC.
customer-success-bot: CS alerted: sending templated note to affected tenants that we have mitigations in place and are investigating root cause.
katie roy: paging status update for customer ops: some customers report latency spikes and 502s from 02:10 to 02:26 UTC. we should collect request ids for correlation.
li wei: autoscaler logs: showing metric emission: 
```
metric_name=ready_replicas value=4 source=autoscaler/eu-west-1 timestamp=1700000000
```
li wei: expected metric_name=available_slots. this will cause router's metric-based rules to think pool is full.
maria gonzalez: can we temporary route eu-west-1 traffic to hosted fallback? risk: higher cost but preserves availability.
alex chen: doing it. changing route table for tenant-scoped rules: set route_target=hosted-fallback for enterprise tenants with >1% error.
samir patel: applied route table change, responses immediately improved for a subset. I'm seeing error rate drop in router logs.
eng-ops-bot: alert suppressed: error-rate(eu-west-1) now 0.9% which is below threshold.
alex chen: create a short-lived patch to autoscaler to emit both metric names until full fix. Maria, can you open a PR?
maria gonzalez: will do. creating branch fix/autoscaler-metric-dual-emit. PR opened: https://git/repo/pull/482. includes unit tests and migration notes.
li wei: monitoring shows pool A coming back to normal after scale. fallback flip-flop stopped after router policy change.
katie roy: confirming customer impact: 12 tenants saw increased errors, 3 had sustained failures >5 minutes. CS outreach in progress.
alex chen: timeline so far:
- 01:58 UTC: autoscaler deploy r-20240301-17 (metric rename)
- 02:10 UTC: first increase in 502s, router fallback begins
- 02:18 UTC: oncall paged
- 02:25 UTC: manual scale + router policy lock applied
- 02:30 UTC: route table shift to hosted for high-impact tenants
- 02:34 UTC: error rates drop under threshold for most tenants
- now: mitigations holding

samir patel: next steps: revert deploy in staging, add canary rule for metric name rename, add alert on metric_name mismatch.
maria gonzalez: I'll coordinate postmortem and mitigation owner. Assigning root cause to autoscaler metric rename; remediation: dual-emit + canary + docs.
li wei: ops follow-up items: 1) revert or patch autoscaler in prod, 2) add router validation of metric existence, 3) tighten fallback hysteresis.
katie roy: CS to send full incident summary to customers; happy to draft.
eng-ops-bot: handoff: alex chen is wrapping primary; oncall shift change in 30m to katie roy who will be secondary for follow-ups.
alex chen: @katie roy I'll sync you on cleanup steps in 20m.
katie roy: thanks. also will coordinate credits for affected tenants.
alex chen: adding quick reproducible snippet for devs to test router behavior locally: 
```bash
# simulate autoscaler metric rename causing fallback
export METRIC_NAME=ready_replicas
python tools/simulate_router.py --metric-name $METRIC_NAME --requests 1000 --pools dedicated-eu-west-1-A dedicated-eu-west-1-B
```

maria gonzalez: I'll run that in canary env and verify PR fixes.
samir patel: closing page and leaving thread for postmortem notes. if anything regresses ping @alex chen or escalate. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident P1 resolved (mitigated) at 02:44:40 UTC. Full postmortem scheduled for 2024-03-02 15:00 UTC.
